scope: Finite actual size selectors and complete central metric expressions only. Source changes, spreads, dynamic size expressions, indirect renderer calls and unreviewed metrics references fail closed.

Tag.consumer:
<Tag
                  key={code}
                  color={
                    code === '200'
                      ? T.green
                      : code === '401' || code === '403'
                        ? T.warning
                        : T.red
                  }
                >

<Tag
                      color={
                        tierByOrg.get(o.id) === 'enterprise'
                          ? T.green
                          : tierByOrg.get(o.id) === 'professional'
                          ? T.champagne
                          : T.muted
                      }
                    >
<Tag color={s.review_status === 'pending' ? T.warning : s.review_status === 'approved' ? T.green : s.review_status === 'applied' ? T.champagne : T.muted}>
<Tag size="md" dot color={item.status === 'closed' || item.status === 'cancelled' ? T.muted : T.blue}>
<Tag size="md" color={capaDue < 0 ? T.red : capaDue <= 7 ? T.warning : T.muted}>
<Tag size="md" dot color={item.status === 'closed' || item.status === 'cancelled' ? T.muted : T.blue}>
<Tag size="md" dot color={status === 'closed' || status === 'cancelled' ? T.muted : T.blue}>
<Tag size="md" dot color={item.status === 'closed' || item.status === 'cancelled' ? T.muted : T.blue}>

<Tag size="xs" color={
                    rep.status === 'pending' ? (overdue ? T.red : T.warning)
                    : rep.status === 'not_required' ? T.muted : T.green
                  }>

<Tag
                        color={
                          p.similarity === 'high'
                            ? T.green
                            : p.similarity === 'medium'
                              ? T.warning
                              : T.muted
                        }
                      >

<Tag
                          color={
                            p.expert_status === 'verified'
                              ? T.green
                              : p.expert_status === 'pending'
                                ? T.warning
                                : T.muted
                          }
                        >

<Tag
          color={
            review.decision === 'approve'
              ? T.green
              : review.decision === 'reject'
              ? T.red
              : review.decision === 'defer'
              ? T.subtle
              : T.warning
          }
        >

<Tag
            color={
              supplement.status === 'open'
                ? T.warning
                : supplement.status === 'responded'
                ? T.blue
                : T.green
            }
          >

Switch.consumer: <Switch checked={v.active} onChange={(next) => set('active', next)} ariaLabel="현장 목록에 표시" />
<Switch checked={novice} onChange={toggle} ariaLabel="화면 안내 펼쳐 두기" />
<Switch checked={enabled ?? false} onChange={toggle} disabled={enabled === null} ariaLabel="이메일 알림 받기" />
